info.name: SaloFresh — Admin / Platform Journey
info.description: End-to-end Postman collection covering the complete SaloFresh Admin/Platform journey: authentication, dashboard & reports, salon/user/review moderation, audit logs, roles & permissions (SUPER_ADMIN), platform monetization plans, support ticket triage, fraud alert review, feature flags, GDPR data subject requests, bulk CSV import/export, maker-checker approvals, payment gateway webhook simulation, and salon payouts. All paths, methods, query params and request bodies were extracted directly from the controller and DTO source under src/main/java/com/salofresh. Seeded bootstrap admin (V2__seed_data.sql): admin@salofresh.com / Admin@12345 (role SUPER_ADMIN).

item.name: 01 Auth
item.description: Admin authentication against POST /api/v1/auth/login (AuthController). No role restriction on the endpoint itself, but every other endpoint in this collection is gated by @PreAuthorize('hasAnyRole(ADMIN,SUPER_ADMIN)') or stricter, so a real ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN user must log in here first. The seeded bootstrap account (V2__seed_data.sql) is admin@salofresh.com / Admin@12345 with role SUPER_ADMIN.

request.description: Login with the seeded SUPER_ADMIN account (email admin@salofresh.com / password Admin@12345, see V2__seed_data.sql). Public endpoint, no role required. Captures accessToken/refreshToken from LoginResponse (data.accessToken / data.refreshToken) into collection variables used by every other request's bearer auth.
Fetch the authenticated admin's own profile summary (UserSummaryResponse). Required role: any authenticated user (isAuthenticated()).
Rotate the refresh token and issue a fresh access/refresh token pair. Public endpoint (no bearer required, token rotation is the credential). Captures the new accessToken/refreshToken.

Change the currently authenticated admin's own password. Required role: any authenticated user (isAuthenticated()). NOTE: left disabled/for-reference in the journey since running it would rotate the seeded admin credential used by this collection.

Revoke the current refresh token and blacklist the current access token. Required role: any authenticated user (isAuthenticated()). Placed at the end of the auth folder for reference; running it invalidates {{accessToken}} for subsequent requests.
Revoke every refresh token for the current admin across all devices. Required role: any authenticated user (isAuthenticated()).

item.name: 02 Platform Dashboard & Reports
item.description: AdminDashboardController + AdminReportController. Required role for every request: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN'). Report endpoints build a ReportDateRangeRequest(fromDate, toDate, groupBy) from required fromDate/toDate query params (ISO date) and an optional groupBy (ReportGroupBy: DAY, WEEK, MONTH; defaults to MONTH).

request.description: Get platform-wide operational dashboard summary (PlatformDashboardResponse: totals for users, salons, pending approvals, bookings, revenue this month). Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Revenue report grouped by day/week/month over a date range (RevenueReportResponse). Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Booking report with completed/cancelled/no-show breakdown over a date range (BookingReportResponse). Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Top salons report ranked by revenue over a date range (SalonReportResponse). Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Customer growth and activity report over a date range (CustomerReportResponse). Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').

item.name: 03 Salon Moderation
item.description: AdminSalonController. Required role for every request: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN'). Filters: verificationStatus (VerificationStatus: PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED), status (SalonStatus: ACTIVE, PAUSED, SUSPENDED, CLOSED).

request.description: List all salons, unfiltered (paged SalonModerationResponse). Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
List salons filtered by verificationStatus=PENDING and status=ACTIVE. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
List salons pending verification approval (paged SalonModerationResponse). Captures the first salon's id into salonId. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Approve a salon's verification (sets VerificationStatus to APPROVED). Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Reject a salon's verification. Body maps to RejectSalonRequest{reason}. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Suspend an active salon. Body maps to SuspendSalonRequest{reason}. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').

item.name: 04 User Management
item.description: AdminUserController. Required role for every request: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN'). Filters: role (RoleName: SUPER_ADMIN, ADMIN, SALON_OWNER, EMPLOYEE, CUSTOMER), status (AccountStatus: ACTIVE, INACTIVE, LOCKED, DEACTIVATED, DELETED).

request.description: List platform users, unfiltered (paged UserManagementResponse). Captures the first user's id into userId. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
List users filtered by role=CUSTOMER. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').

item.name: List Users Filtered by Account Status

request.description: List users filtered by status=ACTIVE. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Get a single user's account details (UserManagementResponse). Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Suspend (lock) a user's account. Body maps to SuspendUserRequest{reason}. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Reactivate a previously suspended user's account. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').

item.name: 05 Review Moderation
item.description: AdminReviewController. Required role for every request: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN'). Filter: status (ReviewStatus: VISIBLE, REPORTED, HIDDEN).

request.description: List reviews, unfiltered (paged ReviewResponse). Captures the first review's id into reviewId. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
List reviews filtered by status=REPORTED, ready for moderation. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Moderate a review by setting its status (e.g. hide a reported review or restore it). Body maps to ModerateReviewRequest{status}. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').

item.name: 06 Audit Logs
item.description: AdminAuditLogController. Required role for every request: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN'). Optional filters: entityName, action (free-text).

request.description: List audit log entries, unfiltered (paged AuditLogResponse). Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').

item.name: List Audit Logs Filtered by Entity & Action

request.description: List audit log entries filtered by entityName and action. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').

item.name: 07 Roles & Permissions [SUPER_ADMIN]
item.description: AdminRoleController + AdminPermissionController. Required role for EVERY request in this folder: hasRole('SUPER_ADMIN') only — plain ADMIN is rejected (403).

request.description: List all system roles with their assigned permissions (List<RoleResponse>). Captures the first role's id into roleId. Required role: hasRole('SUPER_ADMIN').
Get a single role with its assigned permissions (RoleResponse). Required role: hasRole('SUPER_ADMIN').
List all permissions in the platform catalog (paged PermissionResponse). Captures the first permission's id into permissionId. Required role: hasRole('SUPER_ADMIN').
Replace the full set of permissions assigned to a role. Body maps to UpdateRolePermissionsRequest{permissionIds}. Required role: hasRole('SUPER_ADMIN').

Create a new permission in the platform catalog. Body maps to CreatePermissionRequest{name, description}. Captures the created permission's id into permissionId (overwriting the one captured above). Required role: hasRole('SUPER_ADMIN').
Delete a permission from the platform catalog (deletes the permission created above). Required role: hasRole('SUPER_ADMIN').

item.name: 08 Platform Plans
item.description: AdminPlatformPlanController — admin-only CRUD over platform monetization/commission plans (distinct from the salon-owner-facing PlatformBillingController subscribe flow). Required role for every request: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN'). billingCycle enum: MONTHLY, YEARLY.

request.description: List all platform plans, paged (PlatformPlanAdminResponse). Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').

Create a new platform plan. Body maps to CreatePlatformPlanRequest{name, description, price, billingCycle, maxSalons, commissionPercentage}. Captures the created plan's id into planId. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Growth Plan",
  "description": "For salons scaling past their first location",
  "price": 1999.0,
  "billingCycle": "MONTHLY",
  "maxSalons": 5,
  "commissionPercentage": 8.5
}

request.description: Get a platform plan by id (PlatformPlanAdminResponse). Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Update a platform plan. Patch semantics: only non-null fields are applied. Body maps to UpdatePlatformPlanRequest. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Deactivate a platform plan (active=false). Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Activate a platform plan (active=true). Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').

item.name: 09 Support Tickets
item.description: AdminSupportTicketController — platform-admin triage over support tickets raised by any user. Required role for every request: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN'). Filter: status (TicketStatus: OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, RESOLVED, CLOSED).

request.description: List all support tickets, unfiltered (paged SupportTicketResponse). Captures the first ticket's id into ticketId. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').

item.name: List Support Tickets Filtered by Status

request.description: List support tickets filtered by status=OPEN. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Get any support ticket regardless of owner (SupportTicketResponse). Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
List all messages on a ticket, including internal notes (paged TicketMessageResponse). Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Reply to a ticket as admin; internalNote=true flags the message as staff-only. Body maps to TicketMessageRequest{message, internalNote}. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Assign a ticket to a staff user. Body maps to AssignTicketRequest{assignedToId}. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Update a ticket's status. Body maps to UpdateTicketStatusRequest{status}. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').

item.name: 10 Fraud Alerts
item.description: AdminFraudAlertController. Required role for every request: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN'). Filter: status (FraudAlertStatus: OPEN, REVIEWING, RESOLVED, DISMISSED).

request.description: List fraud alerts, unfiltered (paged FraudAlertResponse). Captures the first alert's id into alertId. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
List fraud alerts filtered by status=OPEN, awaiting review. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Resolve or dismiss a fraud alert. Body maps to ResolveFraudAlertRequest{status, resolutionNote}. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').

item.name: 11 Feature Flags
item.description: AdminFeatureFlagController (admin CRUD, keyed by flag key, hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN')) plus the client-facing FeatureFlagController GET /api/v1/feature-flags (any authenticated user, isAuthenticated()). dataType enum: STRING, NUMBER, BOOLEAN.

request.description: List all feature flags, paged (FeatureFlagResponse). Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Create a new feature flag. Body maps to CreateFeatureFlagRequest{key, value, dataType, description}. Captures the created flag's key into flagKey. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Get a feature flag by its key (FeatureFlagResponse). Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').

Update an existing feature flag. Patch semantics: only provided fields are applied. Body maps to UpdateFeatureFlagRequest{value, description, active}. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Client-facing endpoint: list all currently active feature flags as a simple key-value map. Not admin-restricted — required role: isAuthenticated() (any logged-in user, admin included).
Delete a feature flag (deletes the flag created above). Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').

item.name: 12 GDPR Requests
item.description: AdminDataSubjectRequestController — processing of GDPR/DPDP data export & account deletion requests. Required role for every request: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN'). Filter: status (DataRequestStatus: PENDING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, REJECTED). NOTE: process-export, process-deletion and reject are mutually-exclusive real-world actions on the SAME pending request — all three are included here for API coverage, but only one would succeed against a given request in a real run (the others would 409/422 once its status has moved on from PENDING).

request.description: List all data subject requests, unfiltered (paged DataSubjectRequestResponse). Captures the first request's id into requestId. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
List data subject requests filtered by status=PENDING. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Process a pending EXPORT request and generate the data export file. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Process a pending DELETE request and soft-delete the account. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Reject a pending data subject request. Body maps to RejectDataRequestRequest{rejectionReason}. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').

item.name: 13 Bulk Import/Export
item.description: AdminBulkDataController. Required role for every request: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN'). The three export endpoints return Content-Type: text/csv (raw CSV bytes, not wrapped in ApiResponse) — in Postman, use 'Send and Download' or check the raw response body/headers rather than expecting JSON. The import endpoint is multipart/form-data with a single 'file' part (CSV columns: name,type,description,active).

request.description: Export all categories as a CSV file (Content-Type: text/csv, Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=categories.csv). Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Export all salons as a CSV file (Content-Type: text/csv). Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Export all users as a CSV file, excluding sensitive fields (Content-Type: text/csv). Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').

Bulk import categories from a CSV file (multipart/form-data, field name 'file'; columns: name,type,description,active). Returns BulkImportResult{totalRows, successCount, failureCount, errors[]}. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN'). Attach a local CSV file to the 'file' form field before sending (Postman requires a real file on disk; none is bundled with this collection).

item.name: 14 Maker-Checker Approvals
item.description: AdminApprovalRequestController — maker-checker workflow for high-risk admin actions. Create/listMine: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN'). listPending/listAll/approve/reject: hasRole('SUPER_ADMIN') only. A checker may never decide on their own request. actionType enum: LARGE_REFUND, SALON_SUSPENSION, USER_BAN, PAYOUT_OVERRIDE, OTHER.

request.description: Queue a high-risk admin action for checker approval. Body maps to CreateApprovalRequestRequest{actionType, payloadJson, relatedEntityType, relatedEntityId, reason}; payloadJson is a raw JSON string whose shape depends on actionType (here, SALON_SUSPENSION expects {salonId, reason}). Captures the created request's id into approvalId. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').

body.raw:
{
  "actionType": "SALON_SUSPENSION",
  "payloadJson": "{\"salonId\": 5, \"reason\": \"repeated fraud\"}",
  "relatedEntityType": "SALON",
  "relatedEntityId": "5",
  "reason": "Salon has 12 confirmed fraud alerts in the last 7 days; needs checker sign-off before suspension."
}

request.description: List approval requests submitted by the current admin (paged ApprovalRequestResponse). Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
List approval requests awaiting a checker decision (paged ApprovalRequestResponse). Required role: hasRole('SUPER_ADMIN').
List all approval requests, unfiltered. Required role: hasRole('SUPER_ADMIN').

item.name: List Approval Requests Filtered by Status [SUPER_ADMIN]

request.description: List approval requests filtered by status=PENDING (ApprovalStatus: PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, EXECUTED). Required role: hasRole('SUPER_ADMIN').
Approve a pending request and execute the underlying action. Required role: hasRole('SUPER_ADMIN'); the checker must be a different user than the maker who created the request.

Reject a pending approval request. Body maps to RejectApprovalRequestRequest{rejectionReason}. NOTE: only meaningful if the approval above was not already executed (an approval is a one-time terminal decision) — included here for API coverage of the reject path. Required role: hasRole('SUPER_ADMIN').

item.name: 15 Webhook Simulation [noauth]
item.description: PaymentWebhookController — publicly-reachable endpoints (@PreAuthorize("permitAll()"), also listed in SecurityConstants.PUBLIC_ENDPOINTS) that receive Razorpay/Stripe payment gateway callbacks. There is no JWT here; HMAC signature verification (WebhookSignatureVerifier) inside PaymentWebhookService is the real security control. IMPORTANT: the signature header values below are placeholders — signature verification WILL REJECT them with a 403 (ForbiddenException) unless the environment's Razorpay/Stripe webhook secret is configured AND the header is recomputed as a real HMAC over the exact raw request body using that secret.

request.description: Simulate a Razorpay 'payment.captured' event. Verifies X-Razorpay-Signature, logs the event idempotently by event id/body hash, and best-effort reconciles the matching Payment (looked up by payload.payment.entity.order_id) to SUCCESS. No auth (permitAll()); the signature header is the real control and this placeholder value will fail verification unless a real Razorpay webhook secret is configured and the signature recomputed.

exec: pm.test('Webhook responds (200 if signature valid, 403 if placeholder signature rejected)', function () {

request.description: Simulate a Stripe 'payment_intent.succeeded' event. Verifies Stripe-Signature, logs the event idempotently by the top-level 'id' field, and best-effort reconciles the matching Payment (looked up by data.object.id) to SUCCESS. No auth (permitAll()); the signature header is the real control and this placeholder value will fail verification unless a real Stripe webhook secret is configured and the signature recomputed.

exec: pm.test('Webhook responds (200 if signature valid, 403 if placeholder signature rejected)', function () {

item.name: 16 Salon Payouts (Admin)
item.description: AdminPayoutController (controller/payout/, NOT under controller/admin/ — included per grep for @PreAuthorize ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN outside the admin package). Platform-admin salon payout/settlement generation and processing. Required role for every request: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').

request.description: Generate a settlement payout for a salon over a date range. Body maps to GeneratePayoutRequest{salonId, periodStart, periodEnd}. Captures the created payout's id into payoutId. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').

Move a PENDING payout to PROCESSED, assigning a payout reference. Body maps to ProcessPayoutRequest{payoutReference} (optional — omit the body entirely to auto-generate a reference). Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
Move a PROCESSED payout to PAID. Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
List payouts across all salons, paged (SalonPayoutResponse). Required role: hasAnyRole('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN').
